mapper.sql: select a.appeal_id as appealId, a.student_id as studentId, st.student_name as studentName, st.class_id as classId, cl.class_name as className, co.course_id as courseId, co.course_name as courseName, co.credit as credit, a.term as term, a.original_score as originalScore, a.reason as reason, date_format(a.apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as applyTime, a.status as status, a.result as result, a.corrected_score as correctedScore, a.opinion as opinion, a.handler_id as handlerId, t.teacher_name as handlerName, date_format(a.handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as handleTime, s.usual_score as usualScore, s.final_score as finalScore from edu_appeal a join edu_student st on st.student_id = a.student_id join edu_classroom cl on cl.class_id = st.class_id join edu_course co on co.course_id = a.course_id left join edu_teacher t on t.teacher_id = a.handler_id left join edu_score s on s.student_id = a.student_id and s.course_id = a.course_id and s.term = a.term
mapper.select: select a.appeal_id as appealId, a.student_id as studentId, st.class_id as classId, a.course_id as courseId, a.term as term, a.original_score as originalScore, a.status as status from edu_appeal a join edu_student st on st.student_id = a.student_id where a.appeal_id = #{appealId} for update
select max(appeal_id) from edu_appeal where appeal_id like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into edu_appeal (appeal_id, student_id, course_id, term, original_score, reason, apply_time, status, result, corrected_score, opinion, handler_id, handle_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{appealId}, #{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{term}, #{originalScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{reason}, now(), 'PENDING', '', null, '', '', null, #{studentId}, now())
mapper.update: update edu_appeal set status = 'ACCEPTED', result = #{result}, corrected_score = #{correctedScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, opinion = #{opinion}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_time = now(), update_by = #{handlerId}, update_time = now() where appeal_id = #{appealId}

update edu_appeal set status = 'REJECTED', result = '', opinion = #{opinion}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_time = now(), update_by = #{handlerId}, update_time = now() where appeal_id = #{appealId}
